CBS News — live updates page, confirmed 1 October 2026, latest update timestamped 19:53 BST. Headline: "Trump renews threat to resume attacks on Iran after U.S. midterms"

08:22 update: QUOTE (Donald Trump, President of the United States, to TIME magazine): "With Iran, I don't think you could ever have peace."
Trump said it was "possible" he would order new strikes after the midterm elections, adding: "We have a lot of weapons."

Iranian response: Iran's cabinet received the formal US response to its seven-day ceasefire proposal on 1 October. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was set to discuss it in Tehran. Iran's UN mission denied being asked to leave New York early, calling such reports "baseless and worthless news."

12:21 update: US Treasury targeted Iran's automotive and rail industries plus the "A7" shadow banking network with ties to Russia. A Treasury press release highlighted two domestic car producers responsible for over 90% of Iran's auto market.

14:22 update (Strait of Hormuz): three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles on Tuesday; an Iranian official claimed ballistic missiles had hit moving targets for the first time.

No Qatar mediation developments reported in today's updates.
